Sources

This app writes references, never sacred text. Every passage is resolved from a verified corpus when the site is built.

The Quran

Arabic text: Tanzil Uthmani text, copied verbatim with no change, under the Tanzil text licence. Source: tanzil.net. A build check fails if any verse in the output differs from the corpus by a single byte.

Translations: one edition per language, taken from QuranEnc.com (the Encyclopedia of the Noble Quran) and shown exactly as published: no wording is changed, added or removed, and the publisher's own footnote markers are kept. The publisher's notes are shown in English. The edition, its version and the source are listed on this page. No translation is composed by the app. QuranEnc.com asks that its translations are credited to their publisher and to QuranEnc.com, shown with their version number, kept unchanged with their transcript information, updated to the latest version, and shown without inappropriate advertisements; this app follows these terms, is rebuilt when a newer version is issued, and reports any error it finds in a translation to QuranEnc.com. As with any human work, no translation can be free of error.

Other scriptures

Passages from other books are shown openly beside the Quran, as support. Each carries its book and verse number and, where it exists, its original words; its edition and licence are listed on this page. Passages that state the same teaching most clearly are shown first.

Reports and commentary

Hadith and other reports never form the basis of a Step. Where one is mentioned, it is named as a report.

Fonts

All fonts are under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 and are served from this site; none is loaded from Google or any other host. Amiri and Amiri Quran by The Amiri Project Authors (Khaled Hosny); Crimson Pro by The Crimson Pro Project Authors; EB Garamond by Georg Duffner and Octavio Pardo; and, by The Noto Project Authors, Noto Naskh Arabic, Noto Nastaliq Urdu, Noto Serif Hebrew, Noto Serif Greek, Noto Serif Cyrillic, Noto Serif Devanagari, Noto Serif Bengali, Noto Serif Gurmukhi and Noto Sans Syriac. The Quran text is set in Amiri Quran, whole and unsubsetted. Licence texts are included with the files.

Research behind the method

The form of each Step follows the Quran's own way of answering, and is consistent with published research on curiosity, self-explanation and reactance. That research was not about scripture, and the app follows the method because it is the Quran's.
